concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 3 – Statistical Rigor (step 1, median‑split binary outcome)
concerns.text: The median‑split sensitivity sweep fits a logistic regression on the full dataset without any cross‑validation or hold‑out set, then reports AUC, accuracy, and calibration. This yields optimistically biased performance estimates because the model is evaluated on the same data it was trained on.

The pipeline proceeds only if a random 20‑participant subset shows at least one microstate feature with |r| ≥ 0.20. Conditioning downstream analysis on this ‘construct‑validity’ check introduces a data‑driven selection bias (peeking) that can inflate the final model’s apparent predictive power.
